programme.title: Operation Hadal

programme.title: Trouble Girl
programme.desc: Down with ADHD, Xiao Xiao faces school bullies and family issues. Her teacher Paul is her solace, but when she witnesses a secret between her mother and Paul, it adds complexity to her emotions.

programme.title: Once in a Blue Moon
programme.desc: Mei Zhen's family appears to get along but harbours secrets - she struggles at work, her brother hides his separation and their mother fears her past will affect them. Can they overcome these hurdles?

programme.title: All U Need is Love
programme.desc: When a luxury hotel in Hong Kong suddenly becomes a Coronavirus superspreader, guests & the staff are faced with a 14-day trial they may not survive.

programme.title: Panda Plan
programme.desc: Legendary kung fu star Jackie Chan adopts a panda names Hu Hu. When a crime syndicate places a bounty on the panda, Jackie, his agent, and Hu Hu's caretaker embark on a quest to outsmart the villains.

programme.title: Crisis Negotiators
programme.desc: Negotiator Wai is framed for murder. He takes hostages at the police station and demands talk with a former negotiator. As they engage in a tense battle of wits, their perspectives gradually shift.

programme.desc: At the 2008 Beijing Olympics, former volleyball legend Lang Ping coached Team USA to a controversial win over China. She later returned to rebuild China's team and won gold at Rio 2016.

programme.title: L Storm
programme.desc: ICAC officer Luk and Inspector Lau are stuck in their investigation for bribery and money laundering cases. Framed for bribery, Luk risks everything to gather evidence to clear his name.

programme.title: 77 Heartwarmings
programme.desc: After breaking up with Adam, Eva focuses on her career, but Adam is determined to win her back and makes 77 attempts to do so. The situation worsens when a Thai movie idol courts Eva

programme.title: Stand Up Story
programme.desc: Mancer cares for his intellectually challenged father Wah. When Mancer finds solace in stand-up comedy, he turns his life's hardships into comedic gold, from school ridicule to pandemic woes.

programme.title: Inexternal
programme.desc: Ming falls into coma and is transported to a fantasy realm where old Master Turtle teaches him ancient boxing skill to defeat an evil boss. Meanwhile, Ming's mother finds a way to save her son.

programme.title: Mama's Affair
programme.desc: A Hong Kong drama written & directed by Kearen Pang, former talent manager Mei Fung retired to take care of her husband & son, but decides to return to work to find her value in life.

programme.title: Endgame
programme.desc: A remake from the Japanese movie Key of Life, Andy Lau, Xiao Yang and Wan Qian stars in this action comedy about the switched identities of an unsuccessful actor & a professional assassin.

programme.title: Ride On
programme.desc: Master Luo, a retired stuntman, trains his beloved horse Red Hare to be a stunt horse. But due to his debts, he might lose his horse, so he seeks help from his estranged daughter & her boyfriend.

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places
programme.desc: When the reluctant son of a gangster is summoned home to avenge his father's death, he enlists his father's always-drunk bodyguard to help him out.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A Japanese security agent teams up with a master thief to recover counterfeit USD plates until a U.S. Embassy official betrays them and escapes to Korea with the prize.

programme.title: Table for Six
programme.desc: Three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists on dinner together every night, but tensions rises when their girlfriends join the table.

programme.title: Song of Spring
programme.desc: This is a touching story about an 85-year-old mother caring for her 65-year-old daughter with Alzheimer's disease.

programme.title: Untouchable
programme.desc: Right-hand man to a Macau tycoon, Zun Fei, is torn between love and justice amid brutal underworld violence and power struggles. When a deadly gamble turns against him, his life hangs in the balance.

programme.title: Wish Comes True
programme.desc: Fei meets young talent Wai who suffers from a rare disease, and helps Wai find his lost love. Even when they know the drug treating Wai is ineffective, they choose to embrace hope and love together.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: When an unidentified corpse is found at a residential unit, the residents fear that its presence will turn their home into an ill-fated house, leading to a chaotic endeavor to remove the body.

programme.title: Man On the Edge
programme.desc: A triad leader assigns his right-hand man Ah Lok to take charge of the drug trafficking business, but Ah Lok is actually an undercover policeman who unveils a shocking political conspiracy.

programme.title: The Wig
programme.desc: Meng Zhong is a successful lawyer. During an investigation into a court case, he meets a girl who triggers his memories of a rainy night, revealing a long-hidden secret from 20 years ago...

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience
programme.desc: The highest grossing Chinese movie in Hong Kong history, the story tells of a barrister who swears to prove his client's innocence, going against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong.

programme.title: High Forces
programme.desc: An A380 airliner is hijacked by gunmen on its maiden flight. Among the passengers is a security expert, whose daughter is one of the captives. Can he save all the passengers and avert the crisis?

programme.title: The Lychee Road
programme.desc: A single lychee triggers a Tang Dynasty "Mission Impossible"! Junior official Li races 1,000 miles in three days to satisfy a consort's craving - an epic ride of tension, humour and biting satire!

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan seeks help from psychiatrist Dr Jim. As she heals, Jim is haunted by the same disturbances when his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: Flashover
programme.desc: Based on a true story, an earthquake causes the gas pipes in an industrial park to break, resulting in explosions & fires in the area. Firefighters must fight to safeguard lives, including their own.

programme.title: My First Of May
programme.desc: Former squash champion Teng and his wife are devastated by their daughter's muscular dystrophy. Years later, the faint movement of her pinky finger gives them a small but powerful sign of hope.

programme.title: Ready o/r Knot
programme.desc: A couple who first meet at a wedding & have been together for five years, question the institution of marriage from opposing viewpoints. Should marriage always be the 'next step.'?

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: Set three years after Dragon Inn, this sequel depicts a new inn that has risen from the ashes - one staffed by treasure seekers in disguise.

programme.title: Good Game
programme.desc: A desperate internet cafe owner recruits his daughter, a washed-up action star and a failed pro gamer to form a ragtag esports team—all for a HK$500k tournament and one last, no-regrets shot.

programme.title: Wolf Pack
programme.desc: Specializing in overseas security jobs, The Wolf Pack discovers that terrorists are planning to destroy the country's energy source. Lead by Lao Diao, the pack must move out to stop them!

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Caught in an underground fight to pay off debts, talented boxer Jia Yang loses her Olympics dream and quits boxing. A decade later, Coach Li aids her comeback. Can Jia Yang resurrect her boxing dream?

programme.title: Table for Six 2

programme.title: I Did it My Way
programme.desc: As the secretive dark world of online drug trafficking increasingly targets Hong Kong, the police launches a risky and secret operation to bring down one of the most notorious drug lords in Asia.

programme.title: Leap

programme.title: The Panda Plan: Magical Tribe

programme.title: YOLO
programme.desc: After years of self-neglect, Le Ying decides to embrace life anew. Meeting a boxing coach sparks her desire for a fresh start. Despite the challenges ahead, she embarks on a transformative journey.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A huge hit in the HK, this typical Stephen Chow movie combines history, science fiction, martial arts & comedy elements makes it a fun watch.

programme.title: Time Still Turns the Pages

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians: Wind Rises in the Desert
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma escorts the most wanted fugitive across the desert to Chang'an, only to be drawn into a plot that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Hero

programme.title: Out of Order
programme.desc: A successful lawyer's secret affair turns into a nightmare when a corpse unexpectedly turns up in the hotel room, triggering a desperate cover-up that spirals into uncontrollable chaos.

programme.title: The Prosecutor
programme.desc: A young man is wrongly convicted of drug trafficking. A former cop turned prosecutor believes in his innocence and launches an investigation, risking his life and career to find the true perpetrator.

programme.title: I Still Remember
programme.desc: An uplifting sports drama focusing on a property agent who leads an aimless, unfulfilling life & his P.E teacher, as they seek to find purpose in their lives.

programme.title: Project Gutenberg
programme.desc: The HK police is hunting for a counterfeiting gang led by a mastermind known as Painter. They recruit artist Lee Man to help in their quest, but the real identity of Painter surprises everyone.

programme.title: 8 Bucks Tycoon

programme.desc: ICAC officer Lok sets up a special team to investigate a corruption case involving a bank's top executive's use of cryptocurrency to manipulate the trading market.

programme.title: Tristar

programme.title: Under Current

programme.title: Reunion Dinner
programme.desc: When an engaged couple is requested to invite their parents for a CNY client event, the fiance - who is estranged from his mother, fakes a family. However, things spiral out of control.

programme.desc: A sozzled police inspector (Jackie Chan) must pull himself up again after a bungled mission causes his entire team to be wiped out.

programme.title: Our Crazy Adventures

programme.title: Back Home
programme.desc: Wing, who can see ghosts since young, discovers that the visions that once haunted him have become worse in his home. Caught between the living and dead, Wing must bring the truth to light to be free.

programme.desc: Abdullah meninggalkan keluarga bagi mencari rezeki di kota. Di Kota beliau dikenali sebagai Shawn, memperolehi kekayaan selepas melibatkan diri dengan gangterisma dan kelab malam. Murni kemudiannya jatuh cinta dengan Shawn dan berkahwin. Perkahwinan mereka mendapat seorang zuriat lelaki bernama Adam. Shawn mulai berubah dan bertaubat. Setelah beberapa lama, Murni dan Shawn bercadang untuk kembali berjumpa dengan ibunya dan membawa anak mereka bersama. Sesampai di kampung, Shawn (Abdullah) menyedari gadis yang dikahwininya adalah anak kandungnya sendiri. Dia memohon ampun kepada isterinya Aisyah dan ibunya atas ketelanjurannya. Shawn kemudiannya berjumpa dengan seorang ustaz meminta nasihat, dia akhirnya meninggalkan keluarganya dan menghilangkan diri.

programme.title: Mr Stalker… Saya Cintakan Awaklah!
programme.desc: Lutfiya menolak tawaran Syed Fuad untuk berkahwin dengan Raziq kerana tahu yang Raziq tidak menyintai dia. Setelah Lutfiya hampir pergi baru Raziq sedar yang dia sebenarnya menyintai Lutfiya dan bukan lagi Nadine. Tetapi dia terlambat kerana Lutfiya telah membuat keputusan untuk berhijrah ke Australia. Nadine kembali semula ke Kuala Lumpur setelah 3 tahun menyembunyikan diri di Terengganu. Nadine kembali dengan nama baru 'Nilla' dan mula berhijab. Nilla bekerja di sebuah butik milik Lulu dan ibu Nilla, Puan Surina. Ziyan, wartawan Prima Kota diberi tugasan untuk mencari semula cerita tentang Nadine. Ziyan gembira apabila diperkenalkan dengan seorang fotografer kacak bernama Zein Asyraf.

programme.title: Khilaf Asmara
programme.desc: Hanim gembira kerana mamanya sudah mula menerima hubungan dia dengan Luqman. Irma bertemu dengan Tasya untuk memujuknya. Irma menceritakan kisah hidupnya yang hampir serupa dengan apa yang dialami oleh Tasya sekarang. Aizat berterima kasih kepada Irma kerana dia berjaya menceriakan Tasya. Di pejabat, Luqman mengumumkan yang dia akan berkahwin dengan Hanim. Hanim gembira kerana akhirnya Luqman akan menjadi miliknya. Padahal di belakangnya, Luqman curang dengan perempuan lain.

programme.title: Khilaf Asmara
programme.desc: Wan Su seorang janda, mempunyai anak perempuan bernama Hanim. Dia berkahwin dengan Dato Amri seorang duda mempunyai anak bernama Irma. Bagaimanapun mereka terpisah apabila Wan Su meninggalkan suaminya dan membawa Hanim bersamanya. Kini mereka telah berkeluarga. Irma bersama Luqman dan memiliki sebuah spa kecantikan. Hanim bersama Aizat dan mempunyai seorang anak bernama Tasya. Aizat mempunyai perniagaan Food Truck. Hanim kini bekerja sebagai PA kepada Luqman. Sejak itu penampilan dan sikapnya mula berubah.

programme.title: Khilaf Asmara
programme.desc: Irma berjaya mengesan skandal Luqman dengan Hanim. Irma mahu meninggalkan Luqman. Jerry sanggup mengeluarkan modal bagi Aizat memperkembangkan perniagaan Food Truck mereka. Di rumah, Hanim bergaduh besar dengan Aizat, dia menyalahkan Aizat kerana tidak mampu memberinya kemewahan. Hanim meninggalkan rumah.

programme.title: Khilaf Asmara
programme.desc: Luqman berjaya memujuk isterinya semula. Hanim meninggalkan rumah. Tasya sedih kerana mamanya pergi begitu saja. Hanim mendesak Aizat segera menceraikannya. Aizat sedih kerana dia masih sayangkan isterinya itu. Hanim bermalam dengan Luqman yang masih bersikap buaya. Wan Su cuba "memikat" semula bekas suaminya. Irma mengupah orang untuk mengekori suaminya. Irma mengikut jejak Luqman ke hotel dan dia amat terkejut apabila mendapati suaminya sedang bersama dengan kakak kesayangannya Hanim.

programme.title: Khilaf Asmara
programme.desc: Hanim pandai membuat cerita, kononnya Luqman membantunya tinggal di hotel tersebut selepas Aizat menceraikannya. Irma percaya dengan cerita tersebut. Wan Su tidak sukakan Aizat kerana dari keluarga yang miskin. Irma singgah makan di rumah Wan Su, Wan Su asyik menghina Aizat yang dikatakan miskin berbanding dengan Luqman. Satu hari, Irma berjumpa dengan Aizat, Aizat dikatakan memukul Hanim. Irma marahkan Aizat sehingga mahu menceraikan Hanim. Irma mengajak kakaknya tinggal bersama-sama dengannya sementara mendapat rumah baru.

programme.title: DEKO BAJET
programme.desc: Untuk episod ini, pereka bentuk dalaman, Janna Baha selaku pengacara juga akan menghias semula ruang tamu milik keluarga Atiqah dan Farhan di sebuah perumahan di Shah Alam.

programme.title: DESTINASI BAJET
programme.desc: Dengan bajet yang minimum untuk penginapan, makan minum dan cenderahati untuk tiga hari dua malam ikuti pengembaraan cara destinasi bajet. Bersama Zetty Nabila, ikuti pemgembaraan ke Pulau Penang.

programme.title: LUBUK
programme.desc: Rancangan khas yang akan membawa anda ke tempat menarik dari sungai hinggalah ke tempat tersembunyi untuk memancing. Kali ni, kita ke lubuk memancing di Kg. Skudai Kiri, Johor bersama Joe Aziz.

programme.title: GEAR SHOW
programme.desc: Bersama kumpulan Feral membincangkan peralatan muzik serta tips penggunaan dan penjagaan untuk semua peringkat (pemula hingga profesional) dan juga review Acoustic Guitar Natasha NBSG.

programme.title: KEMBARA
programme.desc: Kembara kali ini membawa Azizul Ammar ke, Batang Kali untuk meneroka keunikan di air terjun Lata Gapi.

programme.title: AROMA MASAK
programme.desc: Hani Fadzil selaku hos musim ini akan menyediakan 2 menu istimewa iaitu Makaroni Bebola Daging & Ro3 Karbonara sambil ditemani oleh artis jemputan, Addnan Sarippuddin.

programme.title: 1001 RESEPI PERIUK NASI
programme.desc: Saksikan pelbagai cara menyediakan masak kegemaran semua dengan hanya mengunakan Periuk Nasi sahaja. Dalam episod ini Danny Aidil akan menyediakan Ayam Sisiq, Ayam Adobo & Maruya! Tak percaya jom saksikan!

programme.title: RESEPI MOYANG
programme.desc: Dalam episod ini, hos akan belajar memasak masakan tempatan iaitu Ikan Mee Sarawak. Dihoskan oleh Emilia Han.

programme.title: HURU HARA
programme.desc: Huru hara ini membincangkan tentang dunia hiburan, perjalanan kerjaya tetamu jemputan dan persembahan artis. Artis jemputan pada episod kali ini adalah Faris Tapau, Zack Kirana, Liza Abdullah dan Takahara Suiko.

Award-winning program anchored by David Muir, featuring unforgettable, character-driven true crime mysteries, exclusive newsmaker interviews, hard-hitting investigative reports and in-depth coverage of high profile stories.

programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.
